metadata.title: Cross-Instrument Experimental Systematics and Methodological Pseudo-Degeneracy Analysis

spectrometer_specifications.detectors_and_geometry: 110 Compton-suppressed HPGe detectors in 4pi spherical geometry; 71-element BGO suppression shields
spectrometer_specifications.polarimetry_method: Two-fold planar segmented Ge crystals & inter-detector scattering; Q(662keV) ~ 0.13
spectrometer_specifications.dsam_rdds_features: 37 angular rings; centroid shifts & forward/backward lineshape fitting; recoil v/c ~ 1-5%
spectrometer_specifications.key_limitations: Lower polarimeter analyzing power Q; susceptibility to detector cross-talk; Doppler broadening at v/c > 5%

spectrometer_specifications.detectors_and_geometry: Composite array: 30 Single HPGe, 26 Clover HPGe (4-fold), 15 Cluster HPGe (7-fold); 239 total Ge crystals
spectrometer_specifications.polarimetry_method: Intrinsic 4-crystal Clover polarimetry (inter-crystal scattering at 90 deg); Q(662keV) ~ 0.22
spectrometer_specifications.dsam_rdds_features: Köln coincidence plunger integration; DDCM analysis with gates from above; recoil v/c ~ 1-4%
spectrometer_specifications.systematic_error_budget_pct: 6-10% (geometry efficiency calibration a(E), plunger distance precision ~ 0.2 um)
spectrometer_specifications.key_limitations: Energy-dependent Clover geometric asymmetry a(E) must be calibrated; Cluster add-back Doppler smearing

spectrometer_specifications.detectors_and_geometry: 40 Compton-suppressed HPGe detectors + 80-element BGO inner ball (multiplicity & sum-energy filter)
spectrometer_specifications.polarimetry_method: Selected 90 deg detector pair scattering (limited polarimetry coverage; Q ~ 0.12)
spectrometer_specifications.dsam_rdds_features: DSAM centroid shift and lineshape; inner ball provides entry-state spin/energy gating
spectrometer_specifications.key_limitations: Efficiency limited for high-fold coincidence (gamma^3, gamma^4); polarimetry requires dedicated setup

spectrometer_specifications.detectors_and_geometry: JUROGAM II: 24 Clover detectors + 15 Eurogam tapered Ge; coupled to RITU gas-filled separator + GREAT focal plane
spectrometer_specifications.polarimetry_method: Clover Compton polarimetry (high statistics at 90 deg); Q(662keV) ~ 0.22
spectrometer_specifications.dsam_rdds_features: DPUNS (Derby-Pin plunger) coupled to RITU/JUROGAM for RDDS in very neutron-deficient nuclei
spectrometer_specifications.systematic_error_budget_pct: 5-8% (RITU recoil velocity distribution ~ 10%, recoil-decay tagging provides clean gating)
spectrometer_specifications.key_limitations: Recoil transmission in RITU helium gas (~50%); Doppler correction relies on average recoil angle

spectrometer_specifications.detectors_and_geometry: 4pi tracking array; 36-fold electrically segmented encapsulated HPGe crystals in triple cryostats; NO BGO shields
spectrometer_specifications.polarimetry_method: Gamma-ray tracking polarimetry (PSA + Klein-Nishina tracking); angular selection 70-110 deg; Q(662keV) ~ 0.42
spectrometer_specifications.dsam_rdds_features: Point-by-point PSA Doppler correction (spatial resolution ~ 2-4 mm); enables v/c = 10-50% with FWHM < 4 keV
spectrometer_specifications.systematic_error_budget_pct: 3-5% (PSA voxel smearing, tracking cluster reconstruction threshold ~ 15 mm)
spectrometer_specifications.key_limitations: High computing load for online PSA; sensitivity to crystal temperature/crosstalk; tracking algorithm efficiency at low E

polarimetry_models.formula_klein_nishina_point: Q0(E, 90 deg) = (1 + alpha) / (1 + alpha + alpha^2), where alpha = E_gamma / 511 keV

pr135_case_study.context: 135Pr controversy: Wobbling (Matta 2015 GS) vs Magnetic Rotation (Garg 2015 INGA) vs Tilted Precession (Lv 2022 JUROGAM II)
pr135_case_study.erratum_details: Garg et al., PRC 100, 069901(E) (2019) corrected geometric asymmetry factor a(E) = 1.01229 + 1.17083e-6 * E_gamma
pr135_case_study.methodological_lesson: A small calibration shift in detector efficiency ratio (delta_a ~ 1-2%) changes asymmetry by ~0.24, completely flipping multipolarity assignments when analyzing power Q is modest. Joint P - R_ac analysis (Lv 2022) is required to eliminate dual-solution chi^2 ambiguities.

stopping_power_systematics.ratio_bm1_over_be2_invariance: Strictly invariant under stopping power scale (tau cancels exactly)

side_feeding_trap.mechanism: Unmodeled delayed side feeding (tau_sf ~ 50-100 fs) in DSAM artificially inflates deduced lifetimes of top band states
side_feeding_trap.simulated_trend: Simulated apparent B(E2) drops by a factor of 2.5 between I=16 and I=26 even though intrinsic Qt is completely constant
side_feeding_trap.pseudo_degeneracy_risk: Falsely mimics Antimagnetic Rotation (AMR) or Band Termination
side_feeding_trap.remedy: Coincidence-gated RDDS (plunger) using DDCM with feeding gate from above completely bypasses side feeding

pseudo_degeneracy_matrix.phenomenon: Dipole bands with large B(M1)/B(E2) ratios (> 10 mu_N^2 / e^2 b^2)
pseudo_degeneracy_matrix.intrinsic_physics: Perpendicular coupling of high-j proton particles and neutron holes; shears angle theta_s closes with spin
pseudo_degeneracy_matrix.diagnostic_signatures: B(M1) drops smoothly ~ sin^2(theta_s); B(E2) very small (0.01-0.1 e^2 b^2); parabolic B(M1)/B(E2); J(2)/B(E2) > 100 hbar^2/MeV (e^2 b^2)^-1
pseudo_degeneracy_matrix.pseudo_degenerate_mimics: Chiral doublets, Strongly coupled oblate high-K bands, Octupole E1 bands
pseudo_degeneracy_matrix.critical_discriminant: Negative polarization P < 0 (confirms M1); lack of degenerate partner; J(2)/B(E2) ratio 2 orders of magnitude larger than collective rotor

pseudo_degeneracy_matrix.phenomenon: Dipole bands with large B(M1)/B(E2) ratios (> 10 mu_N^2 / e^2 b^2)
pseudo_degeneracy_matrix.intrinsic_physics: Spontaneous breaking of chiral reflection symmetry by three mutually perpendicular angular momentum vectors (valence proton, valence neutron, core)
pseudo_degeneracy_matrix.diagnostic_signatures: Pair of near-degenerate delta I=1 bands with same parity; interband M1/E2 links; B(M1)/B(E2) large in odd-odd/odd-A; smooth S(I) factor
pseudo_degeneracy_matrix.pseudo_degenerate_mimics: Magnetic rotation, Triaxial shape coexistence, Strongly coupled high-K bands
pseudo_degeneracy_matrix.critical_discriminant: Observation of partner band with delta E -> 0; identical J(2) and identical B(M1), B(E2) in both bands

pseudo_degeneracy_matrix.phenomenon: Dipole bands with large B(M1)/B(E2) ratios (> 10 mu_N^2 / e^2 b^2)
pseudo_degeneracy_matrix.intrinsic_physics: Single nucleon in high-Omega deformation-aligned orbit (e.g. 11/2-[505]) coupled to axially deformed core
pseudo_degeneracy_matrix.diagnostic_signatures: Delta I=1 cascade; B(M1)/B(E2) ~ (g_K - g_R)^2 K^2 / [Q0^2 I^2]; smoothly drops as 1/I^2; constant intrinsic Q0 ~ 2-4 e b
pseudo_degeneracy_matrix.critical_discriminant: Absolute B(E2) is strongly collective (50-100 W.u., NOT suppressed to 1-5 W.u.); B(M1) does NOT drop to zero at shears cutoff; constant Qt measured by RDDS

pseudo_degeneracy_matrix.phenomenon: Dipole bands with large B(M1)/B(E2) ratios (> 10 mu_N^2 / e^2 b^2)
pseudo_degeneracy_matrix.intrinsic_physics: Octupole deformation (beta_3) inducing an intrinsic electric dipole moment D0; alternating parity sequence
pseudo_degeneracy_matrix.diagnostic_signatures: Delta I=1 transitions connecting positive and negative parity states; large B(E1)/B(E2) ~ 10^-4 fm^-2
pseudo_degeneracy_matrix.pseudo_degenerate_mimics: Magnetic rotation shears bands if parity is undetermined
pseudo_degeneracy_matrix.critical_discriminant: Linear polarization: E1 gives POSITIVE polarization P > 0 (asymmetry A > 0), whereas M1 gives NEGATIVE polarization P < 0 (asymmetry A < 0)!

pseudo_degeneracy_matrix.intrinsic_physics: Spontaneous dynamic/static chiral symmetry breaking in triaxial nucleus (gamma ~ 30 deg)
pseudo_degeneracy_matrix.diagnostic_signatures: Degeneracy delta E(I) -> 0 across multiple spins; smooth S(I) parameter; equal B(M1) and B(E2) values in both bands; presence of interband links
pseudo_degeneracy_matrix.pseudo_degenerate_mimics: Triaxial shape coexistence crossing, Signature partners with anomalous decoupling, Octupole parity doublets
pseudo_degeneracy_matrix.critical_discriminant: Degeneracy maintained over >= 4 spin states (not a localized crossing); identical transition quadrupole moments Qt in both bands measured by DSAM/RDDS

pseudo_degeneracy_matrix.intrinsic_physics: Two distinct potential energy surface minima with different deformation (beta_2, gamma) crossing in excitation energy
pseudo_degeneracy_matrix.diagnostic_signatures: Band crossing occurs at a single localized spin; dynamic inertia J(2) differs substantially between bands; interband transitions only near crossing
pseudo_degeneracy_matrix.critical_discriminant: Measured transition quadrupole moments Qt differ significantly (delta Qt / Qt > 30%) between the two bands; sharp crossing in Routhian diagram

pseudo_degeneracy_matrix.intrinsic_physics: Alpha = +1/2 and -1/2 branches of a high-j low-Omega orbital in a gamma-soft core experiencing Coriolis decoupling or signature inversion
pseudo_degeneracy_matrix.diagnostic_signatures: Energy splitting delta E oscillates with spin; large signature staggering in B(M1) (oscillates by factor 3-10 between I and I+1); NO wobbling/chiral interband links
pseudo_degeneracy_matrix.critical_discriminant: Signature staggering in B(M1) transition rates; absence of interband collective E2 transitions

pseudo_degeneracy_matrix.intrinsic_physics: Parity doubling in reflection-asymmetric octupole-deformed nuclei (e.g. 224Ra, 226Th, 225Ra)
pseudo_degeneracy_matrix.diagnostic_signatures: Even-parity and odd-parity rotational sequences separated by a small energy displacement; fast E1 interband transitions
pseudo_degeneracy_matrix.critical_discriminant: States have OPPOSITE parity (confirmed by E1 linear polarization P > 0 and conversion electron spectroscopy), whereas chiral doublets have IDENTICAL parity!

pseudo_degeneracy_matrix.phenomenon: Smoothly decreasing B(E2) with spin in regular Delta I=2 cascade
pseudo_degeneracy_matrix.intrinsic_physics: Two identical high-j blades (e.g. two g_9/2 proton holes) simultaneously closing symmetrically against core/neutron axis; zero net magnetic dipole moment
pseudo_degeneracy_matrix.diagnostic_signatures: B(E2) drops smoothly ~ sin^4(theta_s) by factor 5-10; B(M1) = 0 or strictly forbidden; dynamic inertia J(2) is nearly constant; J(2)/B(E2) > 100 hbar^2/MeV (e^2 b^2)^-1
pseudo_degeneracy_matrix.pseudo_degenerate_mimics: Band termination, Pairing collapse with centrifugal stretching, Uncorrected side-feeding delay artifact
pseudo_degeneracy_matrix.critical_discriminant: Smooth decrease of B(E2) while J(2) remains finite and smooth; band DOES NOT terminate at a finite maximum spin I_max; lifetime confirmed by coincidence-gated RDDS

pseudo_degeneracy_matrix.phenomenon: Smoothly decreasing B(E2) with spin in regular Delta I=2 cascade
pseudo_degeneracy_matrix.candidate_mechanism: Band Termination (Loss of Collectivity via Alignment)
pseudo_degeneracy_matrix.intrinsic_physics: All valence nucleons gradually align their angular momenta along rotation axis until maximum possible spin I_max = sum(j_i) is reached; prolate -> oblate non-collective transition
pseudo_degeneracy_matrix.diagnostic_signatures: Qt -> 0 as I -> I_max; level spacing compresses; J(2) drops abruptly and becomes negative; band terminates abruptly at I_max
pseudo_degeneracy_matrix.critical_discriminant: Dynamic moment of inertia J(2) collapses or becomes negative; the band ends abruptly at I_max (no states exist above I_max for this configuration)

pseudo_degeneracy_matrix.phenomenon: Smoothly decreasing B(E2) with spin in regular Delta I=2 cascade
pseudo_degeneracy_matrix.intrinsic_physics: Unobserved slow continuum cascade (tau_sf ~ 50-100 fs) populating the highest spins; analyst incorrectly assumes prompt feeding
pseudo_degeneracy_matrix.diagnostic_signatures: Apparent B(E2) appears to drop by factor 3-5 with spin; DSAM lineshape forward/backward fits show residual tail discrepancies
pseudo_degeneracy_matrix.critical_discriminant: Re-measurement using coincidence RDDS (plunger) with gate set from above reveals true B(E2) is constant; DSAM lineshape fitting with explicit multi-step feeding cascade
